title: ChatGPT & external AI extensions
detail: Restricts Apple’s external AI integrations. Does not block provider websites, standalone apps, or Apple Private Cloud Compute.

title: External AI account sign-in
detail: Restricts account sign-in only. Anonymous external AI requests may still work unless integrations are also restricted.

title: Keep Dictation on device
detail: Forces Dictation to avoid Siri servers. This is a Dictation-specific policy, not a switch for all Apple Intelligence.

title: Private Cloud Compute
detail: Apple decides when supported requests need server processing. No independent global PCC restriction was found in the reviewed Apple schemas. Turning off external AI does not turn off PCC.

title: Inline text predictions
detail: Local predictive typing preference. Can be changed directly for this user and restored. This is broader than Apple Intelligence.

title: Foundation Models apps
detail: The framework’s system language model runs on device. Apps can separately use networking or their own AI providers. No documented standalone restriction for this framework was found.

title: Xcode predictive completion
detail: Local predictive code completion. Manage in Xcode Settings. No shared model deletion: deleting assets could affect other features.

title: Siri AI features
detail: AI-specific Siri restriction, preserving basic Siri availability. Requires macOS 27 and MDM declaration deployment; cannot be manually installed as a legacy profile.

title: Writing Tools
detail: Routing depends on the operation and OS. Restricts the feature as a whole; does not force its remaining requests to stay local.

title: Genmoji
detail: Uses on-device models in supported configurations. Kept in this group because a feature-level restriction does not certify every current generation mode as local.

title: Image Playground
detail: Processing varies by generation mode and OS, including external integrations. Restricts the entire feature.

title: Mail manual summaries
detail: Restricts manually generated Mail summaries. Apple’s legacy restriction explicitly does not disable automatic summary generation.

title: Mail Smart Replies
detail: Restricts intelligent replies in Mail. No local-only routing guarantee is attached to this feature policy.

title: Safari summaries
detail: Restricts intelligent page summaries. No local-only routing guarantee is attached to this feature policy.

title: Notes transcription summaries
detail: Restricts AI summaries of transcriptions. Leaves the transcription feature itself alone.

title: Calendar & Reminders natural language editing
detail: AI editing restriction for macOS 27. Requires MDM declaration deployment.

title: Visual Intelligence
detail: Feature restriction for macOS 27. Processing may involve cloud services; requires MDM declaration deployment.
